READ (Architecture & Design) is an established architecture office based in New York and Miami, working on projects across multiple scales and typologies. We are seeking an architect in Miami, FL to join our team. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across all phases of a project, demonstrates strong technical and design skills, and is confident taking on a range of responsibilities within a collaborative studio environment.
PROJECT LEVEL ARCHITECT: Within the next 6 months, you will be involved in all phases of architectural projects. The ideal candidate has 7-10 years of professional experience and a strong command of AutoCAD, with the ability to produce complete design and construction drawing sets. All renderings, project development, and detailing are completed in-house. Candidates should demonstrate solid skills and professional judgment across each phase of the project.

We are a small office, almost entrepreneurial environment where every team member is essential. We will prefer highly motivated candidates that are well rounded, want to voice their ideas, learn, and participate in pushing the firm forward with us.
